name: @tiphys/kernel
description: Tiphys kernel: the fleet orchestration toolbelt, delivered as an npm package.

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.src.json tsconfig.test.json && npm run build:schemas && npm run build:runtime-deps
scripts.build:schemas: node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('src/gates/schemas', 'dist/src/gates/schemas', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build:runtime-deps: node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const seen = new Set(); const walk = (name) => { if (seen.has(name)) return; seen.add(name); const from = 'node_modules/' + name; const meta = JSON.parse(readFileSync(from + '/package.json', 'utf8')); cpSync(from, 'dist/node_modules/' + name, { recursive: true }); for (const next of Object.keys(meta.dependencies ?? {})) walk(next); }; for (const dep of Object.keys(JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')).dependencies ?? {})) walk(dep);"
